sourceMarkup: {{CurrencyInfobox |title = Experience |image = Exp.png |type = Evergreen }} ==Description== '''Experience''', normally shortened to '''Exp''', is a form of non-spendable currency that is always rewarded at the end of matches. You can also earn '''Experience''' through other methods, like [[codes]]. While it cannot be spent, it is used in the Level Bar while in the lobby to level up to higher levels. Each time you [[Levels|level]] up, the '''Exp''' in your experience bar resets. [[Levels]] are used to unlock some towers (like the [[Crook Boss]]), give you the ability to buy some towers such as the [[Accelerator]] or unlock certain parts of gameplay (like [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode and [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode). The amount of '''Experience''' earned at the end of a match is multiplied by 1.25x with the [[Gamepasses|VIP gamepass]]. During periods of 50% more '''Experience''' (00:00 UTC Friday – 00:00 UTC Sunday), any '''Experience''' earned is multiplied by 1.5x. Special maps, like [[Pizza Party]] or [[Winter Stronghold]], have modifiers which increase the amount of '''Exp''' you get. For example, in [[Mason Arch]], when [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode is chosen, you receive {{Exp|203}} when triumphing instead of {{Exp|185}}, as the [[All Paths]] modifier increases currency rewards by 10%. It takes the appearance of a blue star. ==Update History== *'''14 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.0|BETA v1.0.0]] **'''Experience''' added. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Experience''' icon added. {{CurrencyNavBox}}
